A single comment, collapsible between a compact one-line preview and a full card. The full view can be maximized into a modal. Fully controlled — all mutations are delegated to the supplied callbacks.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/comments/CommentCard.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CommentCard } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/comments";
```
